decisionSummary: The dev-publish v12/1.3.6 source is canonical. v11/1.3.5 installed and pinned correctly on us.paype.cc and its grain ran CLEAN on an idle host — grain 8wBtLKetY9YBHnKTviyKR5 served 'GET api/messages' over an established WebSocket at 21:26 with zero pthread failures — then hit 'runtime/cgo: pthread_create failed: Resource temporarily unavailable' and exit 2 on a restart at 21:29 while other grains were starting. The defect is therefore load-sensitive under-provisioning of virtual address space, not contention alone and not a deterministic crash (F-262). supervisor.c++ documents both cause and lever: the default RLIMIT_AS starves pthread_create's stack mmap for runtimes whose virtual reservations exceed working-set RSS, and apps override via Manifest.requestedMemoryGiB. This cut adds requestedMemoryGiB = 4, the same fix proven end-to-end for Bureau Doc at 2.0.37.
